# Vault 6 Studios

> Malaysia's dedicated waifu and anime figure store. Every figure is hand-inspected before listing. Free shipping on orders RM100 and above.

## What We Are

Vault 6 Studios is an online collectibles store based in Malaysia, specialising exclusively in waifu and anime figures. We stock scale figures, prize figures, and character figures from Japanese manufacturers and anime franchises.

Every piece in our catalogue is physically inspected before it is listed — we do not list figures with damaged boxes, flawed paint, or misaligned parts.

## Who We Are For

- Anime figure collectors in Malaysia
- Waifu figure collectors looking for a curated, inspection-verified source
- Collectors wanting free shipping on orders above RM100

## Key Facts

- Location: Malaysia (ships nationwide)
- Specialisation: Waifu and anime figures only
- Free shipping: Orders RM100 and above (Peninsula Malaysia)
- Payment: FPX, credit/debit card, e-wallets (via Fiuu)
- Loyalty programme: Tiered membership (RECRUIT → AGENT → OPERATIVE → DIRECTOR)
- Authenticity: Every figure hand-inspected before listing

## Pricing

Figures are priced in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR / RM).

- Prize figures: RM60–200
- Scale figures (1/8, 1/7, 1/6): RM150–800+
- Free shipping: Orders RM100 and above (Peninsula Malaysia)
- Member account: Free

## Competitive Position

Vault 6 is differentiated from general toy stores (ToyPanic, Shirotoys) by:
1. Exclusive focus on waifu and anime figures
2. Lower free-shipping threshold (RM100 vs RM200 at ToyPanic)
3. Per-figure physical inspection before listing
4. Member loyalty programme with wishlist and order tracking
